# OTA Guard
OTA Guard by LISBOA PVT is hotel software that monitors the rates actually displayed on OTAs such as Booking, Expedia, Agoda, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo and Airbnb, 24/7. When a displayed price drifts from the reference price the hotel set, the tool documents the gap and pushes a correction through the hotel channel manager, by API or through the hotel own extranet session. It runs on the hotel own machine, on Windows.
Free 15 day trial, no payment needed. Annual license per hotel. Built by a hotelier and running daily on his own guest house in Goa, India.
Contact, otaguard@proton.me
Site, https://jangalagoa.github.io/OTA-GUARD-Start-the-15-day-trial/
